changelog:
Version 1.1.0 of data_analyzer introduces major new features for automated sales data analysis and reporting:

- Added support for querying, charting, and in-depth trend analysis of sales data.
- New capability to automatically generate standardized weekly sales reports in PDF format, combining statistics, charts, and business insights.
- Enhanced customization of reports with options for title and date range.
- Supports multi-chart embedding and automatic local file storage for easy access.
- Improved workflow for seamless integration of data query, visualization, analysis, and report export.
